sloka: सा च कामैः प्रलोभ्यन्ती भक्ष्यैः भोज्यैः च मैथिली ।न भोक्ष्यति महाभागा दुःख मग्ना यशस्विनी ॥४-६२-७॥
transliteration: sā ca kāmaiḥ pralobhyantī bhakṣyaiḥ bhojyaiḥ ca maithilī ।na bhokṣyati mahābhāgā duḥkha magnā yaśasvinī ॥4-62-7॥

translations.english: 'Immersed in grief, chaste and famed Sita, will not take any food or enjoy pleasures however much she is tempted.
